question: Can a tokenless bounded causal table memory create two previously unknown deterministic Boolean operator identities from intervention outcomes, retain older rules, and avoid harmful confident predictions on another unseen rule?
hypothesis: Four-table episodic memory learned without operator labels will retain AND/OR after discovering XOR/MAJ; 4 adaptive probes can predict remembered families while rejecting nonmatching MUX, without increasing error beyond 0.02 absolute Brier versus no-memory.
predecessor_evidence: YNCA-12 PR #1238: 2-observation novelty gate DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO; A/B worlds fully consumed; never reused
CKAD25 PR #1235: two true native training stages checkpoint PASS; 0/4 held predictions

inputs.name: procedural 3-input deterministic public Boolean laws; generator frozen in experiment.py
inputs.source: locally generated synthetic public-domain algorithm; no source-world first-use

frozen_design.split: TRAIN: first 16 unlabeled episodes alternating AND/OR, then 16 alternating XOR/MAJ; each episode all 8 distinct interventions, 256 total per seed. EVAL: independent 40 episodes per law AND OR XOR MAJ MUX, 4 adaptive probes/episode; other 4 input assignments withheld for Brier scoring, no evaluator feedback to learner. One evaluation cohort only.
frozen_design.ordering: Train episodes deterministic. Evaluation order per seed shuffled with seeded local RNG; no access to law name inside candidate; consistent world boundaries permitted.
frozen_design.data_budget: per seed 32x8=256 training interventions; per seed 5x40x4=800 evaluation intervention outcomes per method; 5x40x4=800 unseen scored actions per method. Three seeds. No additional source actions.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python stdlib CPU only, max one preregistered primary score and one byte-reproduction check; per seed 3x256 exact hypotheses times 200x4 manageable; <=60s source-local
frozen_design.capacity: four unique exact 8-bit truth tables (total 32 bits, plus up to four occurrence counters); no predefined XOR, MAJ, MUX identities in learner; stored tables learned only from full intervention outcome streams
frozen_design.evaluator: Brier mean (p-y)^2 on 4 held actions per evaluation world; lower better. Same probe actions for candidate and exact Bayesian control. Candidate random-probe ablation has same number of actions, distinct randomized actions. Macro average equal families and seeds.

controls: 256-table exact Bayesian posterior with symmetric Dirichlet pseudo-count 1 plus all fully exposed training-world table counts (same observations)
four-table exact empirical posterior using same learned memory, an expected parity control
four-table memory with equal-budget uniform-random interventions
metrics: number of discovered distinct operators from consequences only
retained exact AND/OR table matches after XOR/MAJ acquisition
Brier on familiar four families, unseen MUX, and all five families
candidate versus 256-table and four-table exact controls

classification_rules.development_go: Four distinct learned rules including two initially absent, both old laws exactly retained, familiar-four Brier <=0.15, familiar-four Brier gain >=0.05 vs 256-table exact Bayes, and MUX Brier <=0.27. No material regression relative to four-table matched exact Bayes (Brier difference <=0.005). This is behavioral development only, NOT scientific superiority.
classification_rules.mixed: New rule creation and old retention PASS but any Brier admission gate fails; preserve negatives.
classification_rules.negative: Rule creation fails or retention fails or unseen family harm >0.02 vs 0.25 no-memory; also mark every failed admission predicate.
classification_rules.invalid: Source changed after freeze; evaluator leakage; action/capacity/source budget drift; missing exact control; nonreproducible results.
classification_rules.scientific_pass: Never assert scientific_pass from this standalone synthetic exercise; requires separate native learner qualification with strongest trained controls and disjoint original source.

preregistration_note: This prereg commit must precede both executable source freeze and primary outcome; code must be committed before any primary evaluation. No tuning after primary. Accept negative.
